WITH rating_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(length) AS avg_length,
    AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day_price
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
cross_rating_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(per_day_price) AS mean_per_day_price
  FROM rating_metrics
)
SELECT
  AVG(rm.avg_length) AS avg_of_avg_lengths,
  AVG(rm.per_day_price) AS avg_per_day_price,
  AVG(rm.per_day_price - crm.mean_per_day_price) AS avg_excess_per_day_price
FROM rating_metrics AS rm
CROSS JOIN cross_rating_mean AS crm
WHERE rm.per_day_price > crm.mean_per_day_price

assumptions.assumption: Each rating with films counts once in the cross-rating mean; AVG(length) ignores films with NULL length, and the final averages include only ratings above the cross-rating mean.
